name: v003_incident_schema_state
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_schema_state (installation_id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, schema_version INT NOT NULL, ready INT NOT NULL, checkpoints VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v003_incidents
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, source_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, problem_event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, occurred_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, snapshot_json MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_incident_problem (installation_id, tenant_id, source_id, problem_event_id), INDEX ix_incident_installation (installation_id, tenant_id, id)) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v003_incident_evidence
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_evidence (installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, source_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, problem_event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, external_event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, evidence_json VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_incident_evidence (installation_id, tenant_id, source_id, external_event_id, kind), INDEX ix_evidence_problem (installation_id, tenant_id, source_id, problem_event_id)) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v003_incident_policies
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_policies (installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, tier_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, policies_json MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, tier_id), INDEX ix_policy_installation (installation_id, tenant_id)) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
